thread:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem  I extracted outstanding remediation items and want to align owners + minimal test scopes. We have 6 items.
tom: I'll take the multi-region routing verification and the automated failover script. Planning to run a targeted sim in a sandbox and capture RTO/RPO metrics.
rachel: I'll own backups + restore checklist + IAM gating. I found one expired service account in the DR project; will rotate creds and document.
sasha: Thanks. Proposed mini-game-day: Fri 14:00 PT. Objective: validate routing, snapshot restores, and cache rehydration within a 3h window. Anyone opposed?
tom: Works for me. I'll need the peering and route tables unblocked; will ask infra for temp elevated perms.
rachel: I'll prepare the restore checklist and a short runbook blurb for volunteers. Minimal restore steps I'll include in the thread now:
```
- list snapshots: `gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="labels.env=prod" --limit=1`
- provision dr namespace: `kubectl --context=dr-test create ns dr-smoke`
- restore DB snapshot: `pg_restore --dbname=dr_test_db latest.dump`
- smoke verify: `curl -sS http://dr-smoke.app/health || exit 1`
- sample data check: `python scripts/compare_samples.py --keys=5`
```
sasha: Add an explicit step to record elapsed time for each phase (snapshot fetch, restore, app sanity). We'll need those numbers for SLAs and retro.
tom: Noted. I'll also run a route-flip script and publish a perf timeline. Planning 3 failure modes: zone blackout, region blackout, and degraded peering.
ops-bot: heads-up: please tag test artifacts with `incident:DR-2026` so they auto-attach to the tracker.
rachel: On retention: current snapshots for `redwood-prod` are 30 days. I'll open a ticket to extend to 90 days and add 7-day daily deltas.
sasha: Owners + short deadlines:
- routing verification + script -> tom -> due 2167605000
- restore runbook + IAM fixes -> rachel -> due 2167420000
- game-day coordination + volunteer invites -> sasha -> due 2167356000
- snapshot retention ticket -> rachel -> due 2167380000
- post-game-day retro doc -> all -> due 2167700000
- KV-cache post-failover validation -> tom -> due 2167450000
tom: Regarding KV-cache: we've observed a recurring pattern where miss rates spike after route flips for ~8-12 minutes. I'll add an automated check: post-flip, sample hit/miss for 10m and fail the test if miss rate > 7%.
rachel: Also adding a step: after restore, run a background data-consistency job for 30m and report mismatches >0. This is our rollback trigger if significant divergence is found.
sasha: Risk guardrails: any single test with >20% error-rate or DB checksum mismatch >0 should abort further ops and trigger an on-call page. Add these thresholds to the runbook.
tom: I'll produce the flip script and a short README with safe flags: `--dry-run`, `--measure-only`, `--execute`.
ops-bot: reminder: schedule the dry-run in the calendar and pre-notify on-call 48h prior. Artifacts will be collected automatically.
rachel: I'll publish the runbook PR as draft tonight and link it here. Once PR is ready I'll assign reviewers from SRE and DB teams.
sasha: OK team  I'll create the tracker card, assign P0 to routing and restore doc, and add a column for artifacts. We'll reconvene post-retro to decide retention policy changes long-term. Thanks. :thumbsup:
